versions.changelog:
- Updated description for clarity; now highlights self-hosted detection and free trial.
- Added explicit version field to metadata.
- Revised and expanded tags for better discoverability.
- No changes to usage instructions or endpoint functionality.

Initial release of agent-input-firewall:

- Scans untrusted agent or web text for prompt-injection and jailbreak threats before your agent acts on it.
- Provides a simple API to check any incoming content, with clear safe/unsafe verdicts.
- Free to use during launch; will switch to pay-per-call ($0.01/scan, USDC on Base, no signup) after launch.
- No third-party data sharing—detection is self-hosted and efficient (~60 ms/scan).
- Built for security on agent networks by cheetahsecurity.
